conservation_rules: registered population never exceeds offering capacity
one cadet has at most one active registration per offering
existing valid registrations consume capacity before new registrations
waitlisted candidates do not consume registered capacity
registration changes do not mutate Academy population
rules: Registration and waitlist history are append-preserving.
Materialization, observation and save/load cannot reroll established registration state.
Waitlist promotion requires a real vacancy plus a represented promotion event.
Completion evidence is retained even though final Academy-record integration remains deferred to Step 19.
